messages.subject: MHRM Appropriate Numbers of Iterations
parts:
Dear Colleagues,

We are conducting a simulation study that involves estimating parameters for the multidimensional two-parameter logistic models using the MHRM algorithm. Note that our model designs vary item discrimination sizes, the number of item indicators, cross-loadings, sample sizes, etc.

Currently, we have set NCYCLES = 15000 and think that that number should be sufficient for Stage 3. However, we are seeking guidance for setting the number of iterations for Stages 1 (BURNIN) and 2 (SEMCYCLES). We have looked at several simulation studies and the mirt manual but found little discussion on the optimal number of iterations for Stages 1 and 2.

We would appreciate any and all references and/or suggestions on the number of iterations for all MHRM stages.

Thank you very much in advance.

Best regards,

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: MHRM Appropriate Numbers of Iterations
parts:
If you're performing a simulation study I would remove the burn-in problem altogether and simply set the starting values of each model to something closer to the true population generating parameters. That way you are much more likely to start in a region close to the MLE/MAP sample estimates, and will strongly help avoid any issues related to local minimums if you suspect they exist. 

Phil
